name: Notion Sites
category: Workspace with a public site publisher

pricing.free_plan: Free workspace publishes pages to a notion.site address

capabilities: Pages are databases and documents at the same time
Publishes publicly without a separate website tool
limits: Layout stays close to a document — no real landing page design
Forms are page-based, not a booking flow
summary: Turns a workspace page into a public site for free — strong for reading, weak for anything that needs a form.
